text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I know this is a little sudden, but I have
something
to ask you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I want you to go to the NHK Mile Cup
with me!
Not just to watch! I want you to
run with me!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! Why not?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: At this rate... I'll...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Can you come with me to the training
track for a
sec?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Surprised by her odd request, I
nevertheless
follow her to the training
track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There we find...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Graaaagh! I'm not gonna lose, Sei!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Then keep up with me... Push yourself to
the limit!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... I was so close...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... I win!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Wheeze, wheeze... That's right—I'll train until I drop! This is all for my first-rate comeback at the Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, there's still a lot of work to be
done until
then.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her rivals are all working hard together.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Look at them! The passion! The nobility!
The witty
comebacks and friendly
teasing!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Just watching them makes my blood
tingle! I want
rivals like that!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Of course, they're my rivals. But they're
all on the
Triple Crown tour, and I'm on
my own path.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
My papa told me that when luchadors
use
jumping techniques...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Each one tries to fly higher than the
others. They
use that passion to make
even better techniques.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
But I don't have anyone to compete
with...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
How can I go on like this? Can this even
be called
wrestling?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
So how about it, Trainer? Will you run
with me?
choice_data_list: It's a race, not pro wrestling, though...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Then what about a winning wrestling
match at
least?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Then, what should I do?! Look at me!
Look at
these balled fists, clenched like
iron!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa seems sad that she
doesn't have
any rivals to go toe-to-toe
with.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As far as solutions, only one comes to
mind...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Qué? N-no, that's out of the question.
choice_data_list: Switch to the Triple Crown route?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
My goal is and always has been to win
the Japan
Cup in my classic year!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The dreams of the world's wild condor
will never
waver!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
But... I do also want to run with my rivals!
What
should I do...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's true! There's always next
year...
choice_data_list: Can't we do it after the Classics are over?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ughhh, but that's too far away! I wanna
race them
as soon as possible.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oh, I've got it! In that case...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
King! King! Wanna go to the NHK Mile
Cup with
me?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You know, just for a laugh... Really kill
some time!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! Don't be ridiculous!
Absolutely not!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa's hot young blood is
looking for a
challenge. I could try and
tell her not to be
unreasonable, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is what she wants, and who am I to
say no? I
wonder if there's way she can
test her strength
against her classmates,
at least once.
